newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Mid-West power prices mostly lower with temps.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Mid-West power prices mostly lower with temps.

text.p: U.S. Mid-West spot electricity was trading mostly lower Friday with cool weather dominating the region and already thin demand expected to taper through the weekend, the brokers and marketers said.

On-peak, non-firm next day power for Saturday delivery in the Mid-Continent Area Power Pool (MAPP) was talked at $13.00-14.00, while Sunday was assessed at $11.50-12.50 per megawatt hour (MWh), the sources said.
MAPP on-peak for Monday delivery was assessed at $14.50-16.00 from next day discussion on Thursday at $14.00-16.00.
